about.text: Rubing is a firm, acid-set, non-melting, fresh goat milk farmer cheese made in the Yunnan Province of China by people of the Bai and Sani minorities. Its Bai name is youdbap, meaning "goat's milk".

how.text: Heated milk is curdled with a plant-based sour mixture, then pressed into cakes. Wikipedia gives no temperatures, times or pressing details, so none are given here.

facts.v: Cow's milk is often used instead in Jianchuan
Fist-sized, rounded-brick cakes, creamy white and spongy; unaged, non-melting, with the aroma of fresh goat's milk
Bai (youdbap) and Sani people, Yunnan; mainly the Jianchuan and Heqing areas
